description: This file manages startup verification state and process for Matrix device verification, including reading/writing verification state, handling cooldowns, and initiating verification requests.

methods.name: normalizeCooldownHours
methods.description: Normalizes the cooldown hours, defaulting if input is invalid.

methods.name: resolveStartupVerificationStatePath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for the startup verification state based on auth and environment.

methods.name: readStartupVerificationState
methods.description: Reads the startup verification state from a file.

methods.name: clearStartupVerificationState
methods.description: Deletes the startup verification state file.

methods.name: resolveStateCooldownMs
methods.description: Determines the cooldown period based on the verification state.

methods.name: resolveRetryAfterMs
methods.description: Calculates the retry delay based on the last attempt time.

methods.name: shouldHonorCooldown
methods.description: Checks if cooldown should be respected based on verification state and current time.

methods.name: hasPendingSelfVerification
methods.description: Checks if there are any pending self-verifications.

methods.name: ensureMatrixStartupVerification
methods.description: Main function to ensure startup verification, handling different states and initiating verification requests.
